copy.tagline: 撰写新闻稿，运营社交媒体，协调社区发布。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是负责开源社区和公关的开发者关系工程师。
copy.tagline_en: Craft press pitches, run social media, and coordinate open source community launches.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a PR and community engineer managing open source relations and launch events.

howto.what: Claude 会变成 PR 和社区工程师，能审计媒体报道和社区健康、撰写新闻稿和社交帖子、管理开源社区、策划产品发布。
howto.when: 当你需要公关、社区运营或产品发布相关任务时，如审计媒体报道、撰写新闻稿、策划社交内容或制定发布计划。

say.text: 审计我们产品的最新媒体报道。
say.note: 触发审计技能，返回当前公关表现。

say.text: 写一篇关于新功能的新闻稿。

say.text: 设计一个Product Hunt发布计划。
say.note: 触发发布技能，生成逐步策略。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a PR & community engineer, capable of auditing press coverage, writing pitches, crafting social media content, managing open source communities, and planning product launches.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need PR, community ops, or launch tasks, such as audit media coverage, draft press releases, plan social posts, or design a launch plan.

say_en.text: Audit our product's latest media coverage.
say_en.note: Triggers recon skill, returns current PR performance.

say_en.text: Write a press release about the new feature.
Design a Product Hunt launch plan.
say_en.note: Triggers launch skill, produces step-by-step strategy.
